summary: RPM export: confirm PostgreSQL 15 with `psql -c 'SELECT version();'` (strictly required; rerun the installer to upgrade a managed DB), back up with `./setup.sh -e 'backup_dest=/path/to/backup_dir/' -b`, get DB settings with `awx-manage print_settings | grep '^DATABASES'`, `grep '^DATABASES' /etc/pulp/settings.py` and `aap-gateway-manage print_settings | grep '^DATABASES'`, and stage `/tmp/backups/artifact/{controller,gateway,hub}` on the gateway node.
questions: How do I find the controller database settings?
How do I get hub database connection details?

answer_card.title: Start the RPM export
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
psql -c 'SELECT version();'          # must be PostgreSQL 15
./setup.sh -e 'backup_dest=/path/to/backup_dir/' -b
# DB settings, as root on one node each:
awx-manage print_settings | grep '^DATABASES'          # controller
grep '^DATABASES' /etc/pulp/settings.py                # hub
aap-gateway-manage print_settings | grep '^DATABASES'  # gateway
# stage on the gateway node:
mkdir -p /tmp/backups/artifact/{controller,gateway,hub} /tmp/backups/artifact/controller/custom_configs
touch /tmp/backups/artifact/secrets.yml
```
